_doc: P5 GT1 — GeneralAI selection draw-for-draw golden manifest (the byte/draw-for-draw oracle for the AiReplayGateTest). Generated against the REAL devsam-core GeneralAI::chooseNationTurn + chooseGeneralTurn driven over the live installed scenario_1010 due-general autorun (TurnExecutionHelper::executeGeneralCommandUntil:233-348). EVERY fixture verified byte-IDENTICAL across two capture_ai.php runs on the SAME install before commit (capture-twice). The matched-count gate rises monotonically as the Kotlin F-SEAM + leaf families land; quarantine-entries pin genuinely-unreachable-in-1010 surfaces with a documented PHP reason — NOT fake-green.
capturePattern: raw docker-compose/CLI (mirrors capture_battle): MariaDB 11.4 + php:8.3-cli + composer vendor/; scenario_1010 (174 generals all npc=2, 2 nations, 94 cities, 24 owned). NOT Testcontainers. See README run block + tools/php-golden/capture_ai.php header.
hiddenSeedDoc: LIVE-PINNED (R-GATE §2): read from UniqueConst::$hiddenSeed AFTER this exact install and emitted as the fixture INPUT. It is fresh-random per install (ResetHelper buildScenario, ResetHelper.php:96 bin2hex(random_bytes(16))); a byte-0 desync desyncs EVERY per-general DRBG. Format asserted ^[0-9a-f]{32}$. The Kotlin replay seeds world_state.hidden_seed with this EXACT hex. RE-PIN after every re-install + re-capture (a new install regenerates UniqueConst.php AND every general's stats/placement).

rngLineage.generalAI: GeneralAI.php:153-159 — ONE RandUtil(LiteHashDRBG(Util::simpleSerialize(hiddenSeed,'GeneralAI',year,month,generalId))) built once per general in the GeneralAI ctor, threaded by reference into BOTH chooseNationTurn (officer_level>=5) AND chooseGeneralTurn. The two choose* consume the SAME stream in order: chooseNationTurn first (its draws are the stream prefix, count pinned by nationTurn.drawCountAtNationEnd), then chooseGeneralTurn. seedString = the EXACT Util::simpleSerialize output 'str(32,<hex>)|str(9,GeneralAI)|int(<year>)|int(<month>)|int(<gid>)' (committed per-fixture, byte-for-byte the load-bearing DRBG key).

drawPrimitives._doc: the RandUtilDrawRecorder logs each draw {seq, method, args, result, consumed, stateIdxBefore, bufferIdxBefore}. consumed=false marks a nextBool short-circuit (prob>=1 / prob<=0) that makes NO draw — cursor unchanged. The Kotlin LiteHashDrbg exposes the SAME stateIdx(Long)+bufferIdx(Int) byte fingerprint; the replay asserts value-for-value AND cursor-for-cursor at the FIRST divergent draw.
drawPrimitives.cursorFields: LiteHashDRBG protected int stateIdx (SHA-512 block counter, eagerly 1 after construction) + protected int bufferIdx (byte offset in the 64-byte block) — read via reflection, observe-only.

deviationFromLiveEngine: ONLY the GeneralAI's protected RandUtil $rng is replaced (write-once reflection) with a DRAW-NEUTRAL RandUtilDrawRecorder over a FRESH LiteHashDRBG seeded with the EXACT same 'GeneralAI' seed string. processCommand is NOT run (the AI is READ-ONLY over game entities — general/nation/city/diplomacy rows + a nation_env KV cache — so iterating every due general against ONE pristine install snapshot is faithful: no selection mutates an entity another selection reads). processCommand mutation + its SEPARATE 'generalCommand'/'nationCommand' rng are the long-sim GT3 surface, not the AI-selection surface this gate pins.
dueGeneralOrder: the EXACT executeGeneralCommandUntil query: SELECT no FROM general WHERE turntime < $date ORDER BY turntime ASC, `no` ASC, with $date = MAX(general.turntime)+1s so the WHOLE first-turn cohort (all 174 due generals) is captured in the live execution order. Fixtures ai-turn-000.json .. ai-turn-173.json are emitted in that order (the file index is the due-order index, NOT the generalId).

fixtures.perFixture: {generalId, name, npc, nation, officerLevel, year, month, hiddenSeed, seedString, seedHex, reservedAction, chosenActionCode (RAW getRawClassName(true)), chosenRawArgs (getArg()), reason (do<한글>), drawStream[], drawCount, nationTurn{reservedAction,chosenActionCode,chosenRawArgs,reason,drawCountAtNationEnd}|null}

matchTargets._policy: for each captured due-general turn the Kotlin replay rebuilds the per-general 'GeneralAI' RandUtil(LiteHashDrbg(seedString)) and runs the LIVE AI; asserts (a) the chosen (do<한글> reason, chosenActionCode RAW, chosenRawArgs) for chooseGeneralTurn AND (for lords) chooseNationTurn, (b) the ordered drawStream value-for-value AND stateIdx/bufferIdx cursor-for-cursor at the FIRST divergence, (c) drawCount (and the nation/general split via drawCountAtNationEnd). The draw-COUNT assertion is gate-EXEMPT for documented 0-draw methods (assert ZERO draws, not a stream).
matchTargets.nationGeneralSplit: nationTurn.drawCountAtNationEnd marks the stream prefix consumed by chooseNationTurn
